decision_rule: Prefer a reproducible, redistribution-compatible, Korean-rich training source whose training role can be kept disjoint from P50 PIA/evaluation authority. Dataset size alone is not authority.

candidates.remote_scale: ~106 GB listed on current Hub tree
strengths: Large Korean-script web corpus suitable for from-scratch LM training
risks: Web-style noise and source-domain imbalance remain possible
Common-Crawl provenance means contamination with public benchmarks must be actively checked
ODC-BY attribution/provenance obligations must be preserved
Still Common-Crawl derived, so not independent content-world contact
Korean subset size/composition must be resolved before quota assignment
Potential overlap with FineWeb2 requires URL/text dedup if mixed

candidates.license: CC-BY-SA-3.0 plus GFDL metadata on dataset card
strengths: Useful tokenizer and factual-prose diagnostic source
risks: Genre too narrow for KSGT writing target
ShareAlike/GFDL obligations complicate a clean mainline training-license story

candidates.source: National Institute of Korean Language Modu Corpus
candidates.license: individual corpus use agreement / approved-purpose regime
strengths: High-value Korean language material including newspaper, books, conversation, messenger and web genres
Directly relevant to Korean language technology
risks: Identity verification and individual usage agreement
Use only within approved purposes and periods
External disclosure requires prior NIKL approval and corpus text cannot be included
Poor fit for a maximally reproducible open P50 training mainline

candidates.license: package CC-BY-4.0; each underlying corpus has its own license
risks: Wrapper license does not authorize all contained corpora for uniform training use

mandatory_manifest_fields: remote file list and hashes where available
document count / byte count / token count after filtering
contamination_firewall: Exclude all P47/P48/P49 exact source IDs and texts where hashes are available.
Exclude all planned P50 PIA items before tokenizer or model fitting.
Do not use StyleKQC held-out human anchors, KoLLA evaluation rows, or P49 owner packet as training text.
If a public benchmark may occur in Common Crawl, exact/near-duplicate screen must run before model training.
Cross-corpus Common-Crawl overlap is not independent replication.

authority_resolution.reason: corpus_reservoir_preseal.json predates this external audit and owns P50 reservoir selection.
